security_audit.summary: Most shell-execution alerts are Markdown delimiters or text examples, but nine entries contain genuine CLI commands for installation, generation, or discovery. remediation.suggestion: Pin dependency versions or immutable revisions, and document the trusted publisher before asking users to run installation commands.

remediation.issue: Image and video workflows use an external inference service.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose what data leaves the device, require user consent, and advise users to remove sensitive information from screenshots.

remediation.issue: Installation guidance links to a mutable raw branch document.
remediation.suggestion: Link to a versioned release or commit and summarize the required commands locally for review.

content.value_statement: Teams often struggle to turn app features into clear, compliant store visuals. This skill provides platform specifications, gallery strategy, captions, generation prompts, and preview guidance.
actual_capabilities: Lists screenshot dimensions and format guidance for major iPhone, iPad, and Google Play placements.
Structures screenshot galleries around the first three visible images and later supporting features.
Provides rules and examples for short, benefit-focused screenshot captions.
Supplies belt CLI examples for device mockups, feature scenes, lifestyle images, image stitching, and preview video scenes.
Outlines localization priorities for primary, secondary, and default markets.
Provides Google Play experiment ideas and a final production checklist.
limitations: Image and video generation examples require the belt CLI, an account, and network access.
Store specifications can change, so final dimensions and policies require verification before submission.
Generated device scenes may not reproduce the real app interface accurately and can require manual compositing.
The skill does not upload assets to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.

use_cases.title: Plan a Launch Gallery
use_cases.description: Turn a product brief into an ordered screenshot story with clear benefits and platform-aware dimensions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Design Production
use_cases.description: Define mockup styles, captions, layouts, and generation prompts before creating final visual assets.

use_cases.title: Improve Store Conversion
use_cases.description: Review an existing gallery, identify weak positions, and plan focused Google Play experiments.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Gallery
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-image screenshot plan for [app type]. Lead with [core benefit] and keep every caption under eight words.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting a store listing from a short product description.

prompt_templates.title: Review Existing Screenshots
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [gallery details] for platform sizing, first-three clarity, caption readability, visual variety, and store compliance.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when improving an existing App Store or Google Play gallery.

prompt_templates.title: Localize Captions
prompt_templates.prompt: Write benefit-focused captions for [features] in [language]. Limit each caption to two lines and organize them by gallery position.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when adapting a proven gallery for another market.

prompt_templates.title: Design an A/B Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a store experiment using [traffic], [markets], and [assets]. Define hypotheses, variants, success metrics, duration, and stopping criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when optimizing a live listing with measurable experiments.

output_examples.input: Plan five screenshots for a habit tracker focused on consistency.
Review a Google Play gallery with eight identical device mockups.
output_examples.output: The dimensions may fit, but repeated compositions reduce discovery. Vary framing, lead with the strongest benefit, and test a full-bleed alternative.

output_examples.input: Outline a 30-second preview for a personal finance app.
output: 0-3 seconds: Show the monthly savings result.
10-18 seconds: Show budget alerts and progress.
18-25 seconds: Present a clear spending insight.
25-30 seconds: End with the app icon and value statement.

best_practices: Verify current store dimensions before exporting final assets.
Use the first three positions to communicate value, differentiation, and the most useful feature.
Remove sensitive data before sending screenshots or prompts to external generation services.
anti_patterns: Do not lead with settings, onboarding, or other screens that emphasize effort instead of value.
Do not use long captions that become unreadable at store thumbnail sizes.
Do not publish generated mockups that misrepresent the real interface or available features.

faq.question: Does this skill support both major mobile stores?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Apple App Store and Google Play screenshot planning, formats, gallery structure, and preview guidance.

faq.question: Does it create final images automatically?
faq.answer: It provides generation commands and prompts through belt. Final assets may still require compositing, typography, resizing, and quality review.

faq.question: Is the belt CLI required?
faq.answer: The planning guidance works without belt. The included image and video generation examples require the CLI, authentication, and network access.

faq.question: Are the listed platform specifications always current?
faq.answer: No. Store requirements can change. Verify current dimensions, formats, durations, and policy requirements before submitting assets.

faq.question: Can it help with localization?
faq.answer: Yes. It suggests market priorities and supports translated captions, but native review is recommended for tone and readability.

faq.question: Does it publish screenshots to store consoles?
faq.answer: No. It plans and generates supporting assets but does not submit them to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
